# BP Best Practices Knowledge Base

> Machine-readable knowledge base of proven coding patterns. Before starting new work, load this file, then load the llms.txt for each concern relevant to your task. Load only FOUNDATIONAL entries unless a specific topic is relevant.

## Priority Legend

FOUNDATIONAL = universal patterns every repo should follow -- always load these
RECOMMENDED = strong patterns for matching tech stacks -- load when relevant
OPTIONAL = nice-to-have improvements -- skip unless explicitly asked

## Concerns

### Claude Configuration
- [Claude Config index](practices/claude-config/llms.txt): CLAUDE.md structure, rules, hooks, skills, agents (8 entries)

### Testing
- [Testing index](practices/testing/llms.txt): Vitest, Jest, Playwright, coverage patterns (6 entries)

### Linting & Formatting
- [Linting & Formatting index](practices/linting-formatting/llms.txt): Biome, ESLint, auto-format hooks (3 entries)

### Error Handling
- [Error Handling index](practices/error-handling/llms.txt): Structured logging, error context propagation (2 entries)

### LLM Resilience
- [LLM Resilience index](practices/llm-resilience/llms.txt): Parsing non-strict LLM JSON, parse-only retry, fail-closed verification, directional reconciliation of LLM self-assessments vs deterministic checks, depth-scaled output budgets + truncated-JSON salvage (3 entries)

### Validation
- [Validation index](practices/validation/llms.txt): Validator/grader/scanner design -- what a result can and cannot prove; floor-not-ceiling, monotonic verdict adjustment (1 entry)

### Deployment
- [Deployment index](practices/deployment/llms.txt): Docker multi-stage, Cloudflare, Northflank, Doppler (9 entries)

### Monorepo
- [Monorepo index](practices/monorepo/llms.txt): pnpm + Turborepo, shared packages, workspaces (3 entries)

### Versioning
- [Versioning index](practices/versioning/llms.txt): Semver, changelog enforcement (2 entries)

### Safety
- [Safety index](practices/safety/llms.txt): Read-only-first, permissions gates, PreToolUse hooks, versioned config migration backups, secretless third-party writes (5 entries)

### Documentation
- [Documentation index](practices/documentation/llms.txt): Reference files, plan structure, investigation patterns (2 entries)

### Design Systems
- [Design Systems index](practices/design-systems/llms.txt): OKLCH tokens, guardrails, UX laws review, iframe isolation (3 entries)

### Environment
- [Environment index](practices/environment/llms.txt): Doppler + .env.local, secrets encryption (1 entry)

### Knowledge Bases
- [Knowledge Bases index](practices/knowledge-bases/llms.txt): YAML frontmatter, two-level indexes, ID conventions (1 entry)

### Security
- [Security index](practices/security/llms.txt): Tenant data isolation, customer-controlled support access, audit trails, OAuth 2.1 / MCP resource-server hardening, key rotation, tenant 404s, internal loopback bridge (5 entries)

### Database
- [Database index](practices/database/llms.txt): Drizzle migrations, Postgres patterns, migration numbering discipline (3 entries)

### Dependencies
- [Dependencies index](practices/dependencies/llms.txt): npm audit CI gating, unused-dependency pruning, supply-chain hygiene (1 entry)

### Notifications
- [Notifications index](practices/notifications/llms.txt): Multi-channel fan-out with per-channel failure isolation (1 entry)

### User Feedback
- [User Feedback index](practices/user-feedback/llms.txt): In-app feedback widget to GitHub-issue pipeline, screenshots, redacted browser diagnostics; code template in templates/feedback-widget/ (1 entry)
